attributes.name: Morale
attributes.desc:
A Duplicant's Morale must exceed their Morale Need, or they'll begin to accumulate Stress.

Morale can be increased by providing Duplicants higher quality Food, allotting more Downtime in
the colony schedule, or building better Bathrooms and Bedrooms for them to live in.

personalities.name: Chip

personalities.name: Devon

personalities.name: Edwiredo
personalities.desc: This {0} once rolled his eye so hard that he powered himself off and on again.

personalities.name: Ellie
personalities.desc: Nothing makes an {0} happier than a big tin of glitter and a pack of unicorn stickers.

personalities.name: Frankie
personalities.desc: There's nothing {0}s are more proud of than their thick, dignified eyebrows.

personalities.name: Freyja
personalities.desc: This {0} has never stopped anyone from eating yellow snow.

personalities.name: Gizmo
personalities.desc: {0}s love nothing more than a big juicy info dump.

personalities.name: Gossmann
personalities.desc: {0}s are major goofballs who can make anyone laugh.

personalities.name: Harold
personalities.desc: Get a bunch of {0}s together in a room, and you'll have... a bunch of {0}s together in a room.

personalities.name: Hassan
personalities.desc: If someone says something nice to a {0} he'll think about it nonstop for no less than three weeks.

personalities.name: Higby
personalities.desc: This {0}'s got a song in his heart. Now if only he could remember how it goes.

personalities.name: Jean
personalities.desc: Just because {0}s are a little slow doesn't mean they can't suffer from soul-crushing existential crises.

personalities.name: Jorge
personalities.desc: {0} loves his new colony, even if their collective body odor makes his eyes water.

personalities.name: Joshua
personalities.desc: {0}s are precious goobers. Other Duplicants are strangely incapable of cursing in a {0}'s presence.

personalities.name: Kai
personalities.desc: The secret to a {0}'s perfectly soft hair is marine mineral hair masks.

personalities.name: Leira
personalities.desc: {0}s just want everyone to be happy.

personalities.name: Liam
personalities.desc: No matter how much this {0} scrubs, he can never truly feel clean.

personalities.name: Lindsay
personalities.desc: A {0} is a charming woman, unless you make the mistake of messing with one of her friends.

personalities.name: Mae
personalities.desc: There's nothing a {0} can't do if she sets her mind to it.

personalities.name: Marie
personalities.desc: This {0} is positively glowing! What's her secret? Radioactive isotopes, of course.

personalities.name: Max
personalities.desc: At any given moment a {0} is viscerally reliving ten different humiliating memories.

personalities.name: Maya
personalities.desc: This {0} got her hand crushed in a pneumatic door once. It was the most alive she's ever felt.

personalities.name: Meep
personalities.desc: {0}s have a face only a two tonne Printing Pod could love.

personalities.name: Mi-Ma
personalities.desc: Ol' {0} here can't stand lookin' at people's knees.

personalities.name: Minnow
personalities.desc: {0} always goes with the flow. Unless the flow is going somewhere boring.

personalities.name: Nails
personalities.desc: People often expect a Duplicant named "{0}" to be tough, but they're all pretty huge wimps.

personalities.name: Nikola
personalities.desc: This {0} once claimed he could build a laser so powerful it would rip the colony in half. No one asked him to prove it.

personalities.name: Nisbet
personalities.desc: This {0} likes to punch people to show her affection. Everyone's too afraid of her to tell her it hurts.

personalities.name: Otto
personalities.desc: {0}s always insult people by accident and generally exist in a perpetual state of deep regret.

personalities.name: Pei
personalities.desc: Every {0} spends at least half the day pretending that they remember what they came into this room for.

personalities.name: Quinn
personalities.desc: This {0}'s favorite genre of music is "festive power ballad".

personalities.name: Ren
personalities.desc: Every {0} has this unshakable feeling that his life's already happened and he's just watching it unfold from a memory.

personalities.name: Rowan
personalities.desc: {0}s have exceptionally large hearts and express their emotions most efficiently by yelling.

personalities.name: Ruby
personalities.desc: This {0} asks the pressing questions, like "Where can I get a leather jacket in space?"

personalities.name: Sena
personalities.desc: {0}s only care about three things: gold accents, true crime, and the advancement of nuclear physics.

personalities.name: Sonyar
personalities.desc: {0}s would sooner burn down the colony than read an instruction manual.

personalities.name: Steela
personalities.desc: {0}s aren't programmed to put up with nonsense, but they do enjoy the occasional shenanigan.

personalities.name: Steve
personalities.desc: This {0} is convinced that he has psychic powers. And he knows exactly what his friends think about that.

personalities.name: Stinky
personalities.desc: This {0} has never been invited to a party, which is a shame. His dance moves are incredible.

personalities.name: Travaldo

personalities.desc: This {0} is paralyzed by the knowledge that others have memories and perceptions of them they can't control.

personalities.name: Ulti
personalities.desc: This {0}'s favorite dance move is The Robot. They don't get why others think that's funny.
